attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.hint: An untranslated label is not cosmetic: an option with no English is exactly what made 'navy blue shoes' find nothing.

audit.failed: The audit log could not be loaded.
audit.lede: Who did what, and what the shop refused. It opens on the refusals: a log that leads with successes is a changelog.
audit.title: Audit
audit.emptyFor: Nothing {{outcome}} has been recorded. That is the good outcome.

catalogue.empty: Nothing is published yet. Products are published from the review queue.
catalogue.hint: Everything the shop sells today. Variants are a catalogue decision, made one product at a time.
catalogue.title: Catalogue

orders.empty: No orders yet. Buy something from the storefront and it lands here.
orders.hint: The state machine decides which move is legal. A refused one comes back with the reason, in the server's own words.
orders.title: Orders

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.hint: The column that matters is the combination one: it says what stops applying when this promotion does.

returns.empty: Nothing waiting. A delivered order can be sent back for 14 days.
returns.hint: Approving is a promise; receiving is a fact. Only receiving puts the goods back on the shelf, and damaged goods never do.
returns.title: Returns

reviewQueue.empty: Nothing is waiting for review. Import a catalog to add products.
reviewQueue.failed: The queue did not answer. Try again in a moment.
reviewQueue.hint: Importing never publishes: Draft is why this queue exists, and only publishing makes a product findable.
reviewQueue.title: Review queue

searchEvaluation.degraded: Hybrid search is answering with lexical search, so its column repeats lexical's. That is the degradation working, not a result. The vector layer says:
searchEvaluation.failed: The evaluation did not answer. Try again in a moment.
searchEvaluation.hint: The golden sets the CI gate commits, asked of lexical and of hybrid search against this shop as it is right now. The gate proves a change did not make search worse; this shows whether the running shop gets what the gate measured.
searchEvaluation.idle: Nothing measured yet. Running it asks every golden query twice, once per strategy, and takes seconds rather than milliseconds.
searchEvaluation.noJudged: None of the products the golden sets judge are in this catalogue, so every score is zero. Import and publish the sample catalogue first.
searchEvaluation.notConfigured: This process started without Qdrant and a model server, so hybrid falls back to lexical and both columns match. Tendero__Vectors=true starts them.
searchEvaluation.order: Queries hybrid lost on come first: an average that went up can hide one that went down.
searchEvaluation.running: Asking every golden query of both strategies…
searchEvaluation.title: Search evaluation

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.hint: The shop does not ask for your password — the issuer does. You will come straight back.
signIn.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to carry on where you were.
signIn.noIssuer: The API is not saying which issuer it trusts. Start it with dotnet run --project src/AppHost.
signIn.wrongRole: You are signed in as {{name}} ({{role}}). The backoffice is for the people who run the shop — sign out to use another account.

stock.hint: A count replaces what the shelf holds; it is not an increment. Saving twice changes nothing the second time.
stock.title: Stock

variants.title: Variants
variants.hint: Declare which axes the product varies by. The whole matrix is generated: retiring the combinations that do not exist costs less than creating the ones that do.
